name: phone-stack
title: Phone Stack
description: Stacked phone screens with video. Phone screens rise out of a blur from below one after another, and each new one pushes the stack back: the older screens shrink and step up so only their tops peek out above the newest. Every screen plays its own clip under an iOS status bar. Proportions measured off a reference recording.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/screens/phone-stack?ref=cli — pass one clip per screen as videos; the page and glow are props. — 76 Pro components too — charts, launch scenes, device shots: https://snapcn.dev/docs/pricing?ref=cli-docs
